title: Pont de Normandie
visualBrief: Asymmetric full Pont de Normandie crossing: pale inverted-Y pylons, paired cable fans, curved thin blue-edged deck and15north/11south viaduct piers.
scaleBasis: Main dimensions and construction systems follow the cited CCI Seine Estuaire technical sheet. Approach allocation, exact road curvature and fittings remain reconstructed; see limitations.
geometrySource: Original deterministic Molen mesh generator; no third-party model or bitmap texture.
placementStatus: Approximate sea-plane bridge placement; surveyed vertical/tidal precision excluded.
reviewStatus: medium-fi; current hash-bound acceptance is recorded in qa.json

nativeAxes.origin: Main-span midpoint; original legacy CMH geometry translated-4.4m for approximate global sea-plane display.

sourceFacts.reviewScope: Picture and standard PMTiles exterior/placement review. Original detailed buildNormandie geometry remains unchanged and reproducible; reviewed shared-texture wrapper applies the explicit approximate datum shift and bounded water-contact bases.

limitations: Picture and standard viewer PMTiles approximate crossing fit; no bespoke survey or certified vertical/tidal datum transformation.

Original detailed source geometry and recorded hash remain reproducible; shared-texture wrapper applies-4.4m approximate shift plus bounded water-contact footings. Main-span/crossing dimensions and cable/approach geometry are retained.

Skyline merges paired fine stays into a few representative fans; closer reductions simplify cable hardware, rails and road markings. Shared concrete, stone and painted metal graphs; zero embedded images.

Mapped water flattening is a review fixture and host shore/tides remain data dependent. Road replacement requests connected approach fitting but exact vertical endpoint joins and real traffic are not surveyed. Footprint replacement off; physical-device timings unmeasured.
sourceLicense: Original Molen geometry. Referenced operator documents are consulted, not copied or redistributed.
importReason: Whole-crossing position quantization destroys 0.13 m road stripes and 0.11–0.168 m cables over a 2,141 m envelope. Preserve float positions until a segmented/LOD import is authored.

appearance.identity: Asymmetric full Pont de Normandie crossing: pale inverted-Y pylons, paired cable fans, curved thin blue-edged deck and15north/11south viaduct piers.
appearance.exclusions: Toll plaza, precise foundations, traffic and tidal/engineering datum certification excluded.

geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: The inspected aerial picture supports pale inverted-Y pylons, stay fans, thin blue-edged roadway and approach piers. Retained mapped outline and current standard PMTiles Pont de Normandie bridge roads confirm the main-span midpoint, southward native+X, longer northern approach, width and full crossing length. Mapped main spacing860m is close to source856m and total2141m. A deliberately approximate-4.4m translation adapts the legacy CMH-authored height to a global sea-plane visualization; this is not a certified IGN69/EGM/tidal conversion. Bounded pylon/pier bases extend below the working water plane; mapped PMTiles water masks form the preview shoreline and raw surrounding terrain is retained. Approach road heights remain source reconstructions, with connected host road fitting requested.
